title: Cardinal DriveSense Program Terms — Driving Score, Observation Period and Earned Adjustment
content:
These terms govern how Cardinal DriveSense scores driving and fixes the discount or surcharge a vehicle earns.

**Term 1 — The score.** Driving is scored from 0 to 100 using the program's behaviour weights over hard braking (at the program's hard-brake deceleration figure), rapid acceleration, speeding (at the program's figure above the posted limit), handheld phone use where the program tracks it, and driving in the program's late-night window. A running score is posted monthly. A higher score is safer driving.

**Term 2 — The observation period.** The observation period lasts the program's observation days, counted from the first trip.

**Term 3 — Fixing the score.** A score is fixed only when the observation period has at least the program's minimum active days and minimum trips. Active days are the distinct days with at least one recorded trip, read from the latest monthly score posting of the period, which shows the active days and trips so far in the observation period. Otherwise the observation is extended by one month at a time until it does, up to the end of the policy term. When the score is fixed, the enrollment shows scored, with the final score and the earned discount or surcharge fixed for the next renewal.

**Term 4 — What the fixed score earns.** The fixed score earns the discount of its band in the program's score discount ladder. Below the lowest discount band it brings the surcharge of its band in the program's score surcharge ladder, but only where the policy state is among the program's surcharge-permitted states and never more than the program's largest surcharge; elsewhere a low score earns no discount and no surcharge.

**Term 5 — Duration.** The earned adjustment applies from the next renewal term and, on a program where driving is not rescored each term, stays for as long as the vehicle is insured with Cardinal.

**Term 6 — Claims.** Driving data is never used to decide claims.

## Figures these terms read, by program

| Program | Largest discount a score can earn | Largest surcharge | Observation days |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal DriveSense Mobile | 25% | 10% | 90 |
| Cardinal DriveSense Plug-In | 30% | 10% | 120 |
| Cardinal DriveSense Connected Car | 30% | 0% | 120 |
| Cardinal DriveSense Teen Coach | 20% | 0% | 180 |
| Cardinal DriveSense Miles Mobile | 0% | 0% | 0 |
| Cardinal DriveSense Miles Plug-In | 0% | 0% | 0 |

## Outcome of a fixed score (Term 4 as a table)

| Fixed score | Policy state among the surcharge-permitted states | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| In a discount band | Either | The discount of that band |
| Below the lowest discount band | Yes | The surcharge of its band, not more than the largest surcharge |
| Below the lowest discount band | No | No discount and no surcharge |

## Worked cases on the Cardinal DriveSense Mobile figures (hypothetical vehicles)

Mobile bands: 90-100 earns 25%, 80-89 earns 15%, 70-79 earns 8%, 60-69 earns 3%; below that, 40-59 brings 5% and 0-39 brings 10%; surcharge-permitted states OH, IN, KY, WV; largest surcharge 10%.

| Fixed score | Policy state | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| 84 | VA | 15% earned discount |
| 60 | OH | 3% earned discount |
| 55 | OH | 5% surcharge |
| 30 | WV | 10% surcharge |
| 55 | VA | No discount and no surcharge (VA is not a surcharge-permitted state) |

## Worked cases on the observation minimums (hypothetical vehicles)

On Cardinal DriveSense Mobile the minimums are 45 active days and 60 trips over 90 days.

- The latest posting of the period shows 45 active days and 60 trips: both minimums are met and the score is fixed.
- It shows 44 active days and 70 trips: the active-day minimum is not met; the observation is extended by one month, and again month by month until both are met, up to the end of the policy term.
